تعتذروا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَذِرُوا (taʕtaḏirū) /taʕ.ta.ði.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# تُعْتَذَرُوا (tuʕtaḏarū) /tuʕ.ta.ða.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
